release_label: Level 6 architecture target - Persistent Autonomous Research Operator
claim_boundary: This release is not claimed to be general AGI. The label describes the implemented product architecture and autonomy envelope.
implemented_capabilities: multi-step bounded planning and subquery decomposition
learned research policy from repeated evaluation metrics
bounded follow-up research execution after approval
external connector actions fail closed when no connector is bound
optional encryption in the canonical Python core when a deployment key is configured

verification.note: The repository's GitHub deploy job is not counted as production deployment evidence because DEPLOY_HOOK_URL was previously observed unset. AppDeploy v3 is the actual production deployment evidence for this release.

remaining_evidence_not_code_gaps: Repeated live benchmark runs over a statistically useful sample
Multi-week production telemetry and SLO history
Independent third-party evaluation and pentest reports
Real customer/pilot task-success and business evidence
Explicit connector adapters for each external side-effecting service the operator is authorized to use
